objective: Externally bracket the immutable protocol/environment before source-data access and the exact run receipt after outcome sealing.

pre_anchor.runner_rule: The runner must validate the pre-anchor target, Bitcoin attestation, exact file universe, and every file hash before opening model primitives, prompts, labels, or outcomes.

post_anchor.submission_rule: Immediately after the write-once run receipt is complete, submit its SHA-256 through the registered OpenTimestamps client.
post_anchor.release_guard: The release script must refuse to emit any manifest until the post proof exists, its target equals the run-receipt SHA-256, and either at least one external calendar attestation is serialized for a provisional release or at least one independently verified Bitcoin block is serialized for a final release.
post_anchor.upgrade_rule: Preserve the initial pending proof bytes and hash. Store each upgraded proof as a versioned new file; never overwrite the initial proof.

sandwich_claim.claim: The exact frozen protocol, evaluator, source universe, and environment existed no later than the verified pre-anchor block, and the exact run receipt existed no later than the verified post-anchor block.
sandwich_claim.does_not_claim: External anchors alone do not prove that an arbitrary executable honored the protocol; the pre-anchored runner and receipt reconciliation provide that link.
required_receipt_links: pre-anchor Bitcoin block height and time
post-anchor Bitcoin block height and time after upgrade

schema_anchor_distinction: A schema_chronology_only anchor dates the design but can never authorize source-data access. The later run-specific pre-anchor must use anchor_purpose=run_authorization and seal the complete run universe.
supersedes: The pending, never-authorized v2.0.0 and v2.0.2 submissions plus the unanchored v2.0.1 schema draft; no source-data access occurred under any of them. V2.0.2 already prevented authorization by purpose, but v2.0.3 gives the schema anchor a non-run role and filename.
